title: Onboarding answers — the one record of what the user answered
description: Written by concept-onboard. Keys are the ids of the inputs_optional fields a dialog rendered, with the raw value; the six reserved keys sit beside them. Open, because every skill's input dialog may add field ids.

approved.description: Date the user confirmed the seed table and the answers as read back; absent while anything is unconfirmed.

has_brand.description: Whether an existing brand is there.

confidence.description: Per technology answer: locked is honoured, preferred may be overruled, open is recommended from the project's signals. architecture-techstack reads it in step 1.

rationale.description: The reason the user gave for a technology answer, keyed by answer id.

seeds.description: Inventory of 02_grounding/seeds/: every file there appears once.
The artifact the file seeds, e.g. brief.

grade.description: complete: adopt and skip collecting that ground; partial: a starting point with named gaps; reference: context only.
